definitions.full: H2730. chared חָרֵד verbal adjective of foregoing, trembling ; — חָרֵד Judg 7:3 3 t.; חֲרֵדִים Isa 66:5 ; Ezra 10:3 — trembling (from fear), absolute Judg 7:3 (|| ירא ), 1Sam 4:13 (subject לִבּוֺ , followed by עַל , for , in behalf of); in awe and reverence, at word of God, sq, בְּ Ezra 9:4 ; Isa 66:2 (followed by עַל ), 66:5 (followed by אֶל ); compare ׳ח אל ׳בְּמִצְוַת Ezra 10:3 .

occurrences.englishText: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’ ” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.
When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.
Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me, because of their trespass of the captivity; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
For my hand has made all these things,
